unknowns.question: Is inactive-softmax competition the mechanism of the class-space formation effect?
unknowns.answer: No within the tested fixed-physical-vocabulary development scope: R1C completed 24/24 arms with SOFTMAX_COMPETITION_NOT_SUFFICIENT; this does not globally disprove every softmax interaction.

unknowns.question: Is the Guardian positive result real and does it beat static replay on efficiency without task-ID leakage?
Which tied-row geometry, parameterization/initialization, and optimizer/weight-decay/denominator interaction explains the remaining class-space formation effect?
Can a new skill form at all under a science-preserving parent with a viable dose?
Which retention lever is necessary in which regime; do doses transfer?
Can a certified scoring mode exist?
Does the class-space/representation effect transfer to natural-language tokenization and larger models?
What does a qualified 5B production corpus look like after the Citadel data and evaluation audits?
Can any current or future checkpoint qualify as a research subject?
What do unreachable historical programs contain?
Can a cheap multi-seed Formation-Mux control-capability and checkpoint-metric-resolution preflight move the identity endpoint off the near-zero floor?

scoring_function.formula: VALUE = (info_gain x architecture_impact x dependency_unlocks x p_discriminate) / cost
scoring_function.scales: factors 1-5 integers; p_discriminate 0-1 (decision-model estimate, NOT a measured probability); cost 1-5 (5 = most expensive)
scoring_function.caveat: these are decision-model estimates for ranking only; they are not calibrated probabilities

ranking.basis: FMUX capability/metric and exact-custody gates come first. If they pass, the frozen frontier may recover/continue, after which the preregistered ROLE-TRANSFER-001 design is the successor of record. Corpus/evaluation regeneration proceeds in parallel before natural-language or scale transfer. None is automatic authorization.

result.rank_1_FMUX-CONTROL-METRIC-PREFLIGHT: stable because it is the cheapest prerequisite that can prevent another floor-limited or unrecoverable campaign
result.rank_2_ROLE-TRANSFER-001: stable as the design of record after custody/frontier prerequisites, but it remains execution-blocked and scientifically untested
result.rank_3_CORPUS-REGEN: required parallel work package; it is not a license to start a broad mechanism or scale campaign
result.verdict: Top-three ordering is stable for the current decision state; the old tied-row placeholder is superseded, and completed R1C/CS plus engineering-only K8/TPU are not active science candidates.
